sum: Perimeter Group Inc. offers industrial products and services that support customer missions across a range of niche applications. It comprises six market-leading businesses across two reporting segments: Fire Safety (Perimeter Solutions, Solberg Fire, and Monaco Enterprises) and Specialty Products (PDI, MMT, and IMS). Perimeter Group Inc. was formerly known as Perimeter Solutions, Inc. and changed its name to Perimeter Group Inc. in November 2026. The company was founded in 1963 and is headquartered in Charlotte, North Carolina.
